statusLine.command: input=$(cat); m=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "?"'); u=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // 0' | cut -d. -f1); t=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '(.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0)/1000|floor'); s=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '(.context_window.context_window_size // 0)/1000|floor'); f=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty' | cut -d. -f1); w=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty' | cut -d. -f1); if [ "$u" -ge 85 ]; then c='\033[31m'; elif [ "$u" -ge 65 ]; then c='\033[33m'; else c='\033[32m'; fi; printf "\033[36m%s\033[0m | ctx ${c}%s%%\033[0m (%sk/%sk)" "$m" "$u" "$t" "$s"; [ "$u" -ge 85 ] && printf ' \033[31mLOW CONTEXT - /compact\033[0m'; col() { if [ "$1" -ge 85 ]; then printf '%s' '\033[31m'; elif [ "$1" -ge 65 ]; then printf '%s' '\033[33m'; else printf '%s' '\033[32m'; fi; }; [ -n "$f" ] && printf " | 5h $(col "$f")%s%%\033[0m" "$f"; [ -n "$w" ] && printf " | 7d $(col "$w")%s%%\033[0m" "$w"; echo
